description: CSRM titles for the seeded controls whose vendored catalogue gives no label (D-46, operator decision 15). The seed uses a title only where the catalogue has no label and stores the control name as {number} — {title}. The vendored catalogue files stay as retrieved; the clause, section or identifier stays each control's source reference. supersededTitles lists, per catalogue and control, each title an earlier seed stored, so a seeded start can tell a name the seed wrote (replaced by the current title) from an operator's own (kept).
